data.narrative: The student implemented a comprehensive integration-heavy test suite verifying link redirects, authorization boundaries, IDOR prevention, and data retention purging. All 71 tests execute deterministically and safely against isolated test database sessions, preventing accidental data pollution.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected an integration-heavy testing strategy because mock-heavy unit tests fail to expose issues on boundary interactions with Postgres/Redis databases.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose choice B (integration-heavy) in DECIDE step, highlighting boundaries risk.

dimension_scores.observation: Proved test determinism and isolated test state by executing the entire suite 10 times consecutively under concurrent conditions with zero failures.
dimension_scores.evidence: Executed pytest 10 times consecutively without a single flakiness failure.

dimension_scores.observation: Verifies that token-based auth rejects invalid access, and that users cannot access resources belonging to other principals (IDOR regression).
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified tests/test_auth.py has test_owner_cannot_see_others_link and test_links_requires_auth.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented automated analytics retention tests checking that the purge mechanism successfully removes old records without deleting newer data.
Explained clearly why flaky tests erode developer trust, lead to ignored regressions, and waste deployment pipeline resources.
dimension_scores.evidence: Provided clear documentation on flakiness impact on CI/CD pipelines in progress files.

strengths: Constructed isolated test DB setups ensuring database operations do not pollute production state or cause concurrent test interference.
Wrote a clean, deterministic retention test case verifying that purge routines delete expired entries without touching active records.
data.recommendation: Integrate code coverage tools (like pytest-cov) into local testing to trace execution pathways on error flows.

public_evidence.student_action: Added retention purge integration test case verifying old analytics data is successfully deleted.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Test calls purge_old_clicks(retention_days=30) and verifies DB deletion of 40-day old mock rows while preserving 5-day old rows.
public_evidence.ability: Data lifecycle and retention integration testing
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Ensures automated cleanup logic runs correctly, preventing storage leaks while guaranteeing active data preservation.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Implemented integration-heavy test suite using pytest.
Asserted auth, redirect, IDOR, and retention boundaries.

teaching_approaches.detail: Analyzed unit-heavy vs integration-heavy test coverage and flakiness prevention.
